title: Design: the warning appears in edit without moving the grid
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, three ranges with Default on Margin % 40, tier A on % Off 5 in every range.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Take a screenshot of the grid.
  5. Replace tier A's first-range value with 95.
  6. Take a second screenshot of the grid.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The grid shows in view.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The first screenshot shows no warning icon.

Step 5:

  • An orange triangle appears to the right of tier A's first-range box at once.
  • The triangle sits in space already kept beside the box.

Step 6:

  • Compared with the first screenshot, every column heading and box is in the same place: nothing shifted when the triangle appeared.
  • The triangle still shows beside 95.
